summary: The CustomReportRequest module facilitates users in submitting custom report requests within a web application. It supports several report types (Placement Requests, Student, Student PR History, Staff Users, Sites/Services, and Other), each with its own workflow, required input fields, and validation logic. The module dynamically adapts its forms and validation to the selected report type, integrates with dropdown and chooser controls for entity selection, and handles file uploads when student authorization is needed.
purpose: To collect user input for ad-hoc/custom reporting needs, capturing parameters based on the type of report requested. It enforces validations, supports file uploads, and manages workflow steps for data collection, review, and final submission of custom report requests.

workflows.name: Custom Report Request Submission
steps: Page loads and validates session and URL.
User selects a report type from ddReportType (Placement, Student, Student PR History, Staff, Site, Other).
Relevant input view is activated according to report type.
User completes required fields: purpose, audience, parameters (departments, programs, sites, etc.), and for some types uploads files.
Validation is enforced per report type (required fields, date formats, selection lists).
On submission, parameters are packaged into CustomReportParameter objects.
If creating new report, it's added to the database; if editing, the existing report is updated.
Success sets hidden ID or displays errors if validation failed.

workflows.name: Dynamic Entity Selection
steps: Departments, programs, cohorts, sites, agencies, and services are populated and selected via dropdowns or ListBoxChooser controls.
Selection state is persisted and reloaded for edits.

workflows.name: Student PR History Authorization Workflow
steps: User provides student authorization either by text entry or file upload.
File is saved and referenced by URL for download.

business_rules: Required fields are enforced by validators per report type.
At least one department/program/site/agency must be selected where applicable.
Student authorization is required either as entered text or file upload for Student PR History requests.
Date fields must match specified format and (optionally) be after today.
Checklists for statuses can be 'select all' or 'none'.
Only users with appropriate roles can access/submit relevant report type views.
Submission is only enabled if all validations pass and user has permission.
validations: RequiredFieldValidators for key text fields and entity selectors.
CustomValidator for requested date (if not sysadmin, must be today or future).
Mandatory selection for programs, departments, sites, agencies, and services as relevant.
File upload must be of allowed type (regex validator for file extension).
calculations: Date calculations for term selection (resetDates JS function).
Dynamic concatenation/packaging of selected parameters into delimited strings.
conditions: If report type == OTHER, comments are required.
If report type == STUPH (Student PR History), authorization is mandatory.
If Placement Coordinator, show program selection. If not, show site selection.
Form adapts view and validation group logic based on report type.
system_behavior: Dynamic UI adapts to selected report type.
Client and server validation for all critical inputs.
Populates dropdown lists and chooser controls based on session/user context.
File upload management for student consent.
Displays errors and warnings in dedicated panels.
Finalizes and submits request only if all business rules/validations pass.
exceptions: User prompted if mandatory selections or file uploads are missing.
Error panel displays detailed server-side errors.
content_gaps: No information provided for the structure or schema of the CustomReportParameter object.
Resource labels (e.g., Resources.Custom_Report_Request) are referenced but not defined.
No database schema or backend implementation details.
Exact list of status codes, departments, programs, cohorts, etc. is not present—populated dynamically.
